about: Fistral Beach Surf School and Hire works from the International Surfing Centre on Fistral Beach in Newquay and says it is the only surf school and hire on the beach. It hires boards, wetsuits and paddleboards, and teaches everyone from beginners and kids to advanced surfers. It also runs coasteering, group days and surf weekends.
offers: Group lessons from beginner to intermediate
Kids lessons and a weekly kids surf club
where: International Surfing Centre, Fistral Beach, Newquay (TR7 1HY)
goodToKnow: Lessons include coaching, all equipment, changing rooms, hot showers and secure storage
Discounted hire if you want to keep surfing after a lesson
Book online; terms and conditions are on the website
gaps: No cancellation terms or accreditations stated; hire page not opened
